title.value: Auxiliary Losses for Learning Generalizable Concept-based Models
title.justification: The title accurately describes the primary focus of the paper, which introduces auxiliary losses to enhance concept-based models that are more generalizable.
title.quote: Auxiliary Losses for Learning Generalizable Concept-based Models

extractions.description: The paper proposes enhancements to Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) by introducing cooperative-CBM (coop-CBM) along with Concept Orthogonal Loss (COL) to improve model performance and concept separation. These models aim at improving interpretability and accuracy under various conditions such as distributional shifts, with applications in image classification tasks. The study extensively explores how these models can overcome issues like irrelevant concept representations and information leakage.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on improving the methodology of AI models for better generalization, interpretability, and accuracy, without directly addressing an eco-responsible category or application such as energy efficiency, renewable energy, pollution reduction, etc.
primary_category.quote: The paper does not directly relate to climate change, environmental protection, or any other eco-responsible applications; instead, it focuses on enhancing AI model transparency and accuracy.

secondary_categories.justification: Similar to the primary category, the paper does not address any specific eco-responsible topic as a secondary theme.
secondary_categories.quote: The paper's content is highly technical and driven by a focus on AI model development, without an emphasis on eco-responsible issues.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not fit into any specific eco-responsible sub-category since its primary aim is on improving the concept bottleneck models' performance and interpretability from a technical perspective.
primary_sub_category.quote: The methodologies proposed in this research are not directly linked to environmental or ecological sub-categories.

new_primary_category.justification: The study focuses on enhancing transparency and accuracy of AI models using auxiliary losses; hence it could belong to a newly suggested category focused on improvements in AI model interpretability and effectiveness.
new_primary_category.quote: As a solution to enhance model transparency, Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have gained popularity since their introduction.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically introduces advances in Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) through cooperative methods and concept orthogonal loss to improve their applicability in various tasks.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Concept bottleneck modelss (CBMs) map input images to interpretable concepts, which in turn are used to predict the label.
